balance.afterPlace: {amount} stays on the payment as the customer’s credit balance.
balance.bannerBody: Place it on an invoice when one comes, or refund it.
balance.bannerPlain: Part of this payment is the customer’s credit balance
balance.customerTotal: The customer’s credit balance now, on every payment: {amount}.

held.nothing: Everything of this payment is placed or refunded.

carry.body: {amount} paid beyond what this invoice is worth after its credit notes goes back to its payments: the customer’s credit balance, to place on another invoice or refund later.
carry.explain: Refund it, or keep it as the customer’s credit balance — never both.

held.deposit: A deposit invoice credited is refunded, never carried.
held.noRecord: Needs the right to record payments.
held.nothing: Nothing was paid beyond what it is worth.

carry.noteHint: Kept with the payments’ history (3 to 500 characters).
carry.orRefund: Refused while a refund of its credit notes is due or paid.
carry.title: Carry the credit of {number}

charge.body: A charge billed beside the goods: freight, packaging, samples, a fee or another charge.
charge.ddtHint: An invoice of several DDTs names the DDT of every line.
charge.descriptionHint: Printed on the invoice as typed (in the invoice’s language).

held.deposit: A deposit invoice bills the deposit only.
held.fromReturn: A credit note from a return keeps the return’s lines: delete it and make it again.
held.issued: An issued invoice never changes: a credit note corrects it.
held.noManage: Changing a draft needs the right to manage invoices.
held.noPrice: Prices are not shown to your role.

problem.ddt: Choose the DDT it belongs to.
problem.description: Type the words printed on the invoice.
problem.quantity: A quantity above 0, at most 4 decimals.

charge.title: Add a charge line
charge.vat: Its VAT follows the goods’ (DPR 633/1972 art. 12; to confirm with the accountant).

about.FIFO: What came in first goes out first, at its own cost.
about.MOVING_AVERAGE: Each receipt changes the average cost of what is in stock.
about.STANDARD: Each item at its frozen standard cost; the differences are variances.

costing.accountant: The accountant chose {method} for this company
costing.afterChoose: Asks for a fresh code. The method locks with the first cost posted under it.
costing.explain: The costing method of this company: how stock and work-in-progress are valued (c.c. art. 2426). The accountant chooses it; once the first cost is posted under it, it is locked.

from.TENANT: Follows the method of every company

held.locked: Locked: cost entries rely on it.
held.noRight: Choosing the method needs the right to manage the costing method.
held.same: This is the method in force already.

costing.lockLaw: c.c. art. 2426: a valuation method may change only in exceptional cases, explained in the notes to the accounts — a decision for the accountant, outside this system.
costing.lockTitle: Why the costing method is locked
costing.lockWhy: Changing the method would revalue them.
costing.noRight: The costing method is shown to roles that see costing.

problem.forbidden: Your role may not choose the costing method.
problem.locked: The method is locked now: cost entries rely on it.
problem.moved: Someone changed the method meanwhile: read again.
problem.write: It could not be saved: try again.

costing.provisional: Every cost is provisional until the method is chosen
costing.provisionalBody: Costs are posted already; the method recorded on them says “not decided”.
costing.reasonHint: The accountant’s letter, the board’s decision… (3 to 500 characters)
costing.title: Costing

deferred.after: The legal deadline is the 15th of the next month (DPR 633/1972 art. 21 c.4).
deferred.bulk_one: Create deferred invoice for {count} DDT of {customer}
deferred.bulk_other: Create deferred invoice for {count} DDTs of {customer}
deferred.dialogBody: One deferred invoice (TD24) of every DDT of this month the customer still has to be invoiced for, with their freight and the deposits already invoiced deducted. It is made as a draft: check it, then issue it.

empty.body: No DDT waits for a monthly deferred invoice now.
empty.title: No deferred invoice due

deferred.go_one: Create deferred invoice for {count} DDT of {customer}
deferred.go_other: Create deferred invoice for {count} DDTs of {customer}

held.inDraft: Everything of this month is in a draft already: open the draft and issue it.
held.noManage: Making invoices needs the right to manage invoices.

deferred.someInDraft_one: Some of its DDTs are in {count} draft already: the new invoice takes only what is left.
deferred.someInDraft_other: Some of its DDTs are in {count} drafts already: the new invoice takes only what is left.

refund.afterLater: It waits under Refunds to make until you mark it made.
refund.afterNow: The money counts as given back at once; the credit note’s refund due goes down.
refund.body: Money given back to the customer by bank transfer: for a credit note (what it gives back of money already paid) or for a payment’s credit balance.
refund.failed: Couldn’t load what is to refund
refund.goLater: Record a refund of {amount} to make

held.noPrice: Amounts are not shown to your role.
held.noRight: Refunds need the right to refund payments.
held.offline: Offline: a refund is recorded only with the server’s answer.

refund.none: Nothing to refund: no credit note gives back money already paid.

problem.future: A value date not after today.
problem.nothing: Nothing is left to refund on it.

refund.title: Refund

whenHint.later: Recorded as due; marked made when the transfer leaves.
whenHint.now: The transfer left: its value date and the bank’s reference.

refundLink.noRight: Refunds are made in Payments: your role does not see them.

all.body: Refunds come from credit notes and from customers’ credit balances.
all.title: No refunds yet

closed.body: A refund cancelled while due, or voided once made by mistake, shows here.
closed.title: Nothing cancelled or voided

due.body: Refunds recorded to make by a day show here.
due.title: No refund due

open.body: No credit note gives back money already paid, and no refund is due.
open.title: Nothing to refund

paid.body: Refunds made show here with their bank reference.
paid.title: No refund made yet

held.noVoid: Voiding needs the right to void payments.
held.notDue: Only a refund still to make.
held.voidNotPaid: Only a refund made can be voided.

cancel.body: It will not be made: the customer keeps the credit.
cancel.title: Cancel the refund of {amount}

paid.body: The transfer left: its value date and the bank’s reference.
paid.title: The refund of {amount} is made

void.body: It was recorded by mistake: the money is owed to the customer again.
void.title: Void the refund of {amount}

returnCredit.after: After the issue, a credit note that gives back money already paid shows under Payments › Refunds to make.
returnCredit.body: One credit note (TD04) for each invoice that billed the returned goods, at the credit decided on the return. They are made as drafts: check each one, then issue it.

held.noManage: Making credit notes needs the right to manage invoices.

returnCredit.nothing: Nothing of this return can be credited now.

skip.CURRENCY: its invoice is in another currency
skip.INVOICE_STATE: its invoice cannot be credited (draft or rejected)
skip.NOT_RECEIVED: the goods are not received yet
skip.OTHER_COMPANY: its invoice is of another company
skip.OVER_CREDITABLE: more than its invoice can still credit

returnCredit.title: Credit notes of return {number}

terms.discountHint: Both or neither: the percent and its days.

emptyRows.body: Choose another view in Which terms.
emptyRows.title: No terms in this view

terms.explain: The terms library: how customers pay, printed on quotes, orders and invoices. Quotes copy a customer’s default terms; invoices take their due dates from them.

held.customers_one: {count} customer has them as default terms: give that customer other terms first.
held.customers_other: {count} customers have them as default terms: give them other terms first.
held.noManage: Changing the terms needs the right to manage payment terms.

terms.inUseBody: Their rules stay as they are, so documents and due dates always agree. Their names can change; for new rules, save them as new terms.
terms.inUseTitle: These terms are used by quotes or orders
terms.movedSome: {done} done, {refused} refused (a customer still has them as default, or they changed meanwhile).
terms.name: Name printed (company language)
terms.nameEnHint: On English documents; empty: the name above.
terms.previewNone: The printed words show once the terms check.

problem.code: A code of 1 to 20 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
problem.discount: A discount above 0 and below 100, with its days (0 to 366) — both or neither.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not change payment terms.
problem.from: Choose the event it counts from.
problem.inUse: These terms are used by quotes or orders: their rules are fixed. Save them as new terms instead.
problem.invalid: Something typed is not accepted: check the fields.
problem.moved: Someone changed these terms meanwhile: read again.
problem.name: The printed name, 1 to 200 characters.
problem.oneOrder: At most one instalment on the order: it is the deposit.
problem.share: Above 0 and at most 100, 4 decimals at most.
problem.state: This cannot be done now (it changed meanwhile).
problem.total: The shares total {total}%: they must total 100%.
problem.write: It could not be saved: try again.

terms.skipAugust: Skipping August comes in a later version.

source.ADVANCE: An advance: due the day it was paid (TP03)
source.MANUAL: Due date typed on this invoice

terms.title: Payment terms

terms.usedBy_other: {count} customers have them as default terms.
